title: Payee
tagline: Payee is an AI-powered payroll Dapp enabling automated payment streams through the analysis of real life contracts. By leveraging the Superfluid framework, NFTs are issued to payees once the flow has been initiated.
description: Payee is an AI powered Dapp enabling live stream payments from real life contracts, leveraging the  superfluid SDK and issuing NFTs to prove contract ownership. Users can be either managers or employees. Sign in is handled through Metamask. As a manager I’m able to upload a contract on the platform. It will then be automatically analyzed and get me ready to start sending a stream of money to my employee by a press of a button. After I entered an ethereum address or name and press that button, it will initiate a flow of money coming out of my wallet to his. It will also mint an NFT designating the employee as the owner of the NFT to symbolise ownership of the contract and proof of the payment stream going in. In case there is a disagreement and the contract needs to be stopped and the user will be able to burn his/her NFT. This application is aiming to solve scam contracts issues and ensure everyone gets paid on time without any middle man and any additional effort.
how_its_made: Python AI API to retrieve data from contracts communicating with Azure OCR to perform computer vision techniques, Node, Typescript API leveraging superfluid SDK to create payment streams, React frontend to interacts, Figma for UX/UI Design.
